info.title: API.SH: Apple Music
info.description: The Apple Music API from API.SH: public Apple Music data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
An artist's discography, newest first: albums, singles and EPs with release date, track count, genre, explicit flag and artwork. Page through it with `offset`; `next_offset` is null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/apple-music-artist-albums

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Artist id, or pass `url` with the artist link instead.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Apple Music's most-played charts by country. With `genre`, that genre's top chart in the store instead (songs, albums or music videos; `genre` and `genre_id` in the response, same item fields).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/apple-music-charts

parameters.name: genre
parameters.description: A genre: alternative, anime, blues, childrens-music, christian, classical, comedy, country, dance, electronic, fitness, hip-hop, holiday, j-pop, jazz, k-pop, latin, metal, new-age, pop, r-and-b, reggae, rock, singer-songwriter, soundtrack, world, or a numeric genre id. Not with type=playlists.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Apple's music genre tree for a storefront: every genre and subgenre with its id, link and top-songs and top-albums chart feeds, as a tree and as a flat list with depth. Pass a genre id to get one branch.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/apple-music-genres

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Genre id (default 34, all music; e.g. 14 Pop, 18 Hip-Hop/Rap).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
One music video on Apple Music (title, artist, album, length, genre, release date, price, preview, artwork, link), or with `artist_id` all of an artist's music videos.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/apple-music-music-video

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Music video id or music.apple.com music-video link.

parameters.name: artist_id
parameters.description: An artist's id: list their music videos instead.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: With artist_id: videos to return, up to 200 (default 50).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
An Apple Music playlist: name, curator, description, last update, artwork, track count and total duration, and every track with artist, album, duration, explicit flag, release date, genre and a 30-second preview link.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/apple-music-playlist

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Playlist id (pl.xxxxxxxx), or pass `url` with the playlist link instead.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
